name: The Legend of Stalvan
summary: In Moonbrook, The Legend of Stalvan leads back to Darkshire's records. A dusty, unsent letter from an old footlocker proves Stalvan Mistmantle stayed there before his trail went cold.

sections.title: A Forgotten Trace in Moonbrook
sections.body: You find a dusty, unsent letter in an old footlocker while tracing Stalvan Mistmantle's past. Moonbrook was once an agricultural settlement, but now lies in ruin, crowded with outlaws and restless specters. Few remember Stalvan's brief stay, yet the letter places him in the hamlet.

sections.title: A Haunting at the Footlocker
sections.body: Disturbing the footlocker draws a Forlorn Spirit from the shadows to guard what remains. The spirit attacks with bewitching magic and the debilitating Curse of Stalvan. Sorrow and dark enchantment still cling to Stalvan's belongings.

sections.title: Updating the Town Registry
sections.body: You carry the letter across the border to Darkshire, where Clerk Daltry needs it for the town records. He finds it strange that the letter was never mailed, but the evidence confirms Stalvan's connection to Moonbrook. The records can now point toward where Stalvan fled next.

faq.q: What is inside the old footlocker in Moonbrook?
faq.answer: The footlocker holds a Dusty Unsent Letter from Stalvan Mistmantle's stay in Moonbrook. It confirms he lived in the town before disappearing.

faq.q: Why does a spirit attack when the chest is opened?
faq.answer: A Forlorn Spirit guards Stalvan's forgotten possessions and attacks anyone who disturbs the trunk. It uses unsettling magic, including fears, polymorph spells, and the Curse of Stalvan.

faq.q: Why take the letter to Clerk Daltry?
faq.answer: Clerk Daltry oversees Darkshire's town records and registry. He needs documentation of Stalvan's past whereabouts before he can help track him further.

faq.q: Why is it significant that the letter was never sent?
faq.answer: The abandoned letter remained in the footlocker, suggesting Stalvan left abruptly or grew paranoid. Its presence deepens the mystery around his movements.

faq.q: What does the Curse of Stalvan do?
faq.answer: The Forlorn Spirit's Curse of Stalvan is a debilitating hex that lowers all of its victim's primary attributes for ten minutes.

faq.q: Where does the trail lead after giving the letter to Daltry?
faq.answer: After Clerk Daltry records the proof from Moonbrook, he can direct you toward Stalvan's next known destination.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you help Darkshire record the shadowy figures who have crossed the region's borders.
As a priest, you can see how a Forlorn Spirit bound to a simple chest of keepsakes carries an emotional burden that did not end in death.
As a mage, you recognize the shade's deceptive arcane tools, from polymorph to a crippling curse, among the unnatural forces in Stalvan's wake.
